title: Psychedelic Dream Portrait
description: A close-up of a serene woman's face with closed eyes, rendered in deep purple tones, surrounded by intricate glowing mandalas, floating circular patterns, and swirling cosmic smoke against a vibrant neon background.
prompt: Close-up portrait of a serene woman's face with closed eyes and purple skin tones, surrounded by intricate glowing blue and cyan mandalas, sacred geometry circles, and floating esoteric symbols.
